q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 24, 2026. The Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close. This means resolution occurs in approximately **2 days**.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has provided official forward guidance of **$91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027, which translates to a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion. This guidance was issued on May 20, 2026 (during their Q1 FY2027 earnings release).

Wall Street's consensus estimate is approximately $91.9 billion, which falls squarely within NVIDIA's guided range.

With only 2 days until the earnings announcement, the forward guidance number is already publicly known and highly unlikely to change materially. Companies typically issue forward guidance once per earnings cycle, and revisions would only occur if there were a significant, unexpected development (which would likely have already leaked or been disclosed).

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm or slightly adjust their Q2 FY2027 guidance around the $91.0 billion midpoint, staying within or very close to the already-disclosed $89.2-$92.8 billion range.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- An unexpected major customer cancellation or significant demand deterioration discovered just before earnings
- Geopolitical/export restrictions affecting China revenue more severely than anticipated
- Serious supply chain disruption requiring downward guidance revision
- Major competitive loss or market share shift

These scenarios are possible but unlikely given the short timeframe and the fact that guidance was just issued in May.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better-than-expected demand from hyperscalers or AI infrastructure customers
- Accelerated adoption or pricing power stronger than anticipated
- Relaxation of China export restrictions allowing incremental revenue
- Higher ASPs (average selling prices) due to product mix

While upside is possible, companies are generally conservative with guidance and tend to underpromise/overdeliver rather than the reverse. An aggressive upward revision just 3 months into a quarter would be unusual.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the CURRENT RESEARCH provided:
- Q1 FY2027 guidance was $91.0 billion ± 2% ($89.2–$92.8 billion)
- Wall Street consensus for Q2 FY2027: ~$91.9 billion
- Year-ago Q2 quarter (Q2 FY2026): $46.7 billion

The company showed massive growth (nearly 2x) from the prior year. However, with guidance already issued and only 2 days remaining, the question is essentially asking what the already-announced guidance will be.

---

## Reasoning on the range provided (99.5–115.5 billion)

The forecast range given (99.5–115.5B) appears quite wide and positioned substantially *above* the current guidance of 89.2–92.8B. This suggests either:
1. The range was set with expectations of upward revision, or
2. The range is deliberately wide to accommodate uncertainty

However, given that NVIDIA issued guidance just 3 months ago and it's only 2 days until earnings, guidance revisions this soon would be unusual unless there were a major development. The probability of guidance revising up by $7-8 billion (to the 99.5B floor) seems low.

Most likely, the actual guidance will fall in the lower-to-middle part of the provided range, clustered around $89-93 billion.

---

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, as of its Q1 FY2027 earnings release on May 20, 2026, is \$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This implies a range between \$89.2 billion and \$92.8 billion [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

Wall Street analysts, according to Yahoo! Finance, have an average revenue estimate of approximately \$91.9 billion for Q2 FY2027, which falls within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This guidance represents a significant year-over-year increase from the \$46.7 billion reported in the year-ago quarter [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).
